address: 16 Cavendish Square, Marylebone, London, W1G 9DD, United Kingdom
bio: Ornate high ceilings and deep green banquettes create an elegant look for this formal French restaurant, which is more food orientated than the Paris original. Attractively presented, modern French dishes are accompanied by an exceptional wine list, which includes Château Lafite Rothschild back to 1897 and Château d'Yquem back to 1924. There are also 110 wines available by the glass, with 4 different pairings (covering 4 price brackets and 2 sizes), suggested for each dish....
